body.message:
Hi,
I appreciate the response, but I need to be very clear.
It is now 11am. The incident happened at 11pm last night. That is 12 hours. Pest control only just showed up this morning — after I had to repeatedly escalate. This is not acceptable for a health and safety emergency involving a rodent and a 4-month-old infant.
To be specific about what went wrong:

No emergency line was available or functional at any point during the night.
No one from your team was reachable for 12 hours during an active pest incident.
When you finally responded this morning, the first solution offered was maintenance — not relocation.
A relocation was only proposed after I explicitly threatened to go to the authorities. That should have been your first response at 11pm, not your last resort at 11am.

I did not wait for your alternative unit. I had already booked another property at my own expense (700 AED) at 2am because your team left us with no option.
I am now requesting a direct refund from fäm Living for the original reservation AND reimbursement of the 700 AED emergency booking. I have already submitted a formal claim with Airbnb Support.
If this is not resolved promptly, I will be filing formal complaints with the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism and the Dubai Tourism Police. This is not a threat — it is the appropriate next step given what happened.
Rashad Karanouh
